text: Allah made him die... for one hundred years.
He passed a town in ruins, and asked: how could Allah ever bring this back to life?
When he woke, he was asked: how long did you stay? He said: a day, or part of a day.
It was one hundred years. His food had not changed at all... but his donkey was only bones.
Then Allah raised the bones, and covered them with flesh. And he said: I know that Allah is over all things competent.
